channel.title: Violations Watch: Mozambique
channel.description: New incidents reported in Mozambique. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Insurgents kill six and abduct others in southern Cabo Delgado mining areas (Zitamar)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Cabo Delgado, Mozambique. Types: Killing of civilians, Abduction & hostage-taking. Alleged perpetrator: Islamic State-linked insurgents. Reported casualties: 6 killed. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1894

item.title: Six people killed by insurgents in Nangade district, Cabo Delgado (AIM)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Nangade, Cabo Delgado, Mozambique. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Insurgents. Reported casualties: 6 killed. Disputed or caveats: May overlap with the Zitamar report of six killed in southern Cabo Delgado. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1895
